# `rand`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a random value with independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) uniformly distributed values in [0, 1).

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
rand([seed])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [0, 1] |
| Deterministic | no |

## Examples

```sql
-- rand, example 1
> SELECT rand();
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- rand, example 2
> SELECT rand(0);
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- rand, example 3
> SELECT rand(null);
-- the result differs on every run
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
